name: Mornington Peninsula Retro Caravans
signature: Restored 1950s–60s themed caravans 500 metres from Rye beach — dog-friendly in designated units, the clearest glamping-adjacent option on the bay side
editorNote:
Thirteen themed retro caravans at Kanasta Caravan Park, restored and styled to a 1950s and 1960s aesthetic, 500 metres from Rye's bay beach. Named units — each styled distinctly — with select vans carrying an electric stove-top, fridge, microwave, and air-conditioning. Dogs welcome in designated units at $22 per night.

This is not a thermal-wellness proposition. The appeal is character, beach proximity, and the dog-friendly format — it is the clearest answer on the Peninsula for a glamping-adjacent stay where dogs are genuinely welcome and the bay beach is a short walk. The price range sits at the accessible end of the Peninsula overnight market.
whyWeGo: Styled retro caravans, 500 metres from Rye beach, dogs welcome — the most accessible glamping-adjacent option on the bay side.
ifOnlyOneThing: Book a unit with air-conditioning for summer and confirm dog policy for your specific breed before booking.
dogFriendlyNotes: Dogs welcome in designated units at $22/night fee. Confirm breed and size when booking.
